text:
Sam (PM): Quick thread on scorecard header: prefer 'Open scorecard' primary or 'Approve & update' primary? Need clarity and safety.
Tess (Design): Lean toward 'Open scorecard' as primary. Users often inspect before approving. Keep approve smaller but visible.
Ravi (Product): Agreed. Copy must state consequences: 'Approve & update baseline' vs 'Mark reviewed'. Avoid single-word CTAs.
Marta (Eng): Backend supports both. Suggest inline confirm for single test (tiny popover) and modal for bulk. Add data-qa tags: data-qa=scorecard-open, data-qa=approve-bulk.
June (A11y): a11y rules: when confirm popover appears, move focus into it and announce via aria-live polite: "Confirm baseline update for Test 4". Buttons need clear aria-labels.
Tess (Design): Visual: success = green chip 'Approved', failures show error banner with link to logs. Contrast>=4.5:1. Tooltip on approve shows keyboard shortcut 'A'.
Sam (PM): Keyboard shortcuts: scope to list focus ('A' approve row, Shift+A bulk) and show hint next to header. Prevent clashes with Cmd/Ctrl.
Ravi (Product): Bulk modal microcopy draft: "Approving will write new baselines for X tests. This can be reverted within 10 minutes. Run diffs first." Include 'Run diffs' link.
ci-bot: baseline-update started for run 521 9 ETA 18s.
June (A11y): also ensure toasts use role=status and don't steal focus.
Marta (Eng): Will implement ARIA hooks and QA attrs; will add telemetry for approve type.
Tess (Design): I'll update Figma and post link.
Sam (PM): Next steps: Tess mock, Marta add hooks, June SR pass, Ravi final copy. Target PR early next week.
